sentences.japanese: 興奮がおさまった時、話し合いが再び始まった。
sentences.english: When the excitement died down, the discussion resumed.

sentences.japanese: 我々は再び戦争をしてはいけない。
sentences.english: We must not go to war again.

sentences.japanese: 火山が再び活動を始めた。
sentences.english: The volcano has become active again.

sentences.japanese: 一度ここを発つと、再び戻ることはできない。
sentences.english: Once you leave here, you can't come back again.

sentences.japanese: 医者や病院は、再び健康体になれる人々の手助けをすべきです。
sentences.english: Doctors and hospitals should help the people who can get healthy again.
